mechanics.title: Converting a villager
mechanics.description: The villager must be an unemployed adult. Right-click it with the conversion item to give it the matching profession.

mechanics.title: Drop chances
mechanics.description: Each conversion item's drop chance is configurable; the chances listed are the defaults from the author's README.

vanilla_changes.change: Overrides minecraft:blocks/player_head to copy profile, note block sound, custom name, item name, lore and custom data from the block entity, so broken heads keep their data.

qol: Villagers from the Miniblock Traders datapack are automatically converted to the matching profession
getting_started: Find a conversion item (many come from fishing treasure or structure chests), then right-click an unemployed adult villager.
editor_notes: Pack author's own mod. README lists 25 professions; the lang file lists 26 conversion items (one extra to check; the README list above gives 26 rows, so the '25' count in the README may be stale). Structure-chest conversion items interact with Lootr (per-player loot). The Arboriculturist/Pomologist leaf drop rates are very low (1 in 4096).
name: Miniblock Merchants
summary: Adds 25 new villager professions that sell nearly 1,000 miniblocks (small decorative blocks) for building. An unemployed adult villager is converted to a profession by right-clicking it with that profession's conversion item, which comes from a rare drop or a structure chest.
